run_metadata.coverage_summary: SEVERELY DEGRADED RUN. This session's network egress policy blocked ALL direct WebFetch requests: every buyer- and government-originated domain attempted returned EGRESS_BLOCKED (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com/Discovery, infrastructure.gov.au). Consequently no tender detail page or specification document could be opened, so no deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values or contacts could be extracted or verified this run. Only the WebSearch tool (Anthropic-side index) was available, which returns titles/URLs and short snippets. Discovery was therefore limited to headline-level signal corroborated across search snippets that pointed to a buyer-originated source. Tier 1 (AusTender + state portals), Tier 2 (councils/GBEs/universities/health) and Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals) could NOT be directly queried or read; where a specific current opportunity was strongly corroborated by search it was captured at headline level only. Nothing was fabricated.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of degraded run): all WebFetch calls were denied by the session egress proxy with error EGRESS_BLOCKED. Confirmed blocked hosts this run: www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, service.ariba.com, www.infrastructure.gov.au. This appears to be an organisation/network-policy restriction on this session, not a site outage — prior runs successfully fetched these. Recommend allowlisting Australian tender domains for this scheduled routine so detail extraction can resume.

Tier 1 core portals (AusTender, buy.nsw/tenders.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders) could not be queried directly this run because WebFetch was blocked; only incidental WebSearch snippets were available. No exhaustive Tier 1 sweep was possible.
Tier 2 (local councils via VendorPanel, GBEs such as Sydney/Melbourne/SA Water, universities, health districts) could not be crawled or read; detail unverified.

Tier 3 MANDATORY corporate channel: SAP Ariba Discovery (service.ariba.com/Discovery.aw) and major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, banks, telcos) could NOT be reached via WebFetch. Search confirmed these portals exist and use Ariba/GCMS/registration but no publicly-visible current corporate opportunity could be captured or verified this run. No corporate tenders fabricated. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.

Detail/deliverables extraction was impossible for every opportunity this run because tender detail pages and documents were unreachable. The single captured tender is headline-level only and is counted in entries_pending_detail.
The one captured opportunity's closing date/time comes from a WebSearch snippet, not from the notice itself; it should be re-verified against the buyer portal on a run with fetch access.

tenders.reasoning: Discovered via WebSearch. The tender title, tender id (CON00839), publish date (20 Aug 2026) and closing date/time (16 Sep 2026, 10:00am) were corroborated across two independent WebSearch result snippets that pointed to the buyer-originated Coffs Harbour City Council TenderLink e-tendering portal (portal.tenderlink.com/coffsharbour). The tender detail page could not be opened to extract scope/deliverables because all WebFetch egress was blocked by the network policy this run.
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY due to the egress block — the detail page and tender documents were unreachable (WebFetch EGRESS_BLOCKED). Deliverables, key_deliverables, scope_of_work, requirements, eligibility, evaluation_criteria, value, contract term and contacts are NOT captured and are left null/empty rather than inferred. Closing date/time is from a search snippet and should be re-verified against the portal on a run with fetch access. Currently open as of run date 2026-09-07 (closes 2026-09-16).
